_comment: HF repo id → { active: number }. Manual override for MoE active params when automated estimation is unreliable. See docs/data-sources.md §2.
_comment_k2_horizon: k2_horizon is a brand-new custom architecture (trust_remote_code, generated off Qwen3-MoE) with a second, independent MoE layer inside attention (self_attn.v_experts.N — mova_num_experts / mova_num_experts_per_tok), which the generic estimator has no model for at all. Figures below are exact counts from summing real safetensors shard-header tensor shapes (per docs/data-sources.md's shard-header method) rather than the config formula: mlp experts scaled by num_experts_per_tok/num_experts, v_experts scaled by mova_num_experts_per_tok/mova_num_experts, everything else counted in full. Verified against safetensors.total (37,444,792,020 / 379,167,159,168) with full tensor coverage.
_comment_muse_spark_open: Gated repo: config.json 401s without an access-approved HF token, so the estimator never sees the routing and the point fell back to dense. Card: 816B total / 42B active (62 layers, 256 experts, 8 routed). Cross-checked against transformers' MuseSparkTextConfig: per-layer attention + 2×8192×4096 expert pool/unpool + 8×3×4096² routed, ×62, plus untied embed/lm_head ≈ 41.9B.
_comment_gpt_oss: gpt-oss keeps the routed width in plain intermediate_size (Mixtral convention). OpenAI model card: gpt-oss-20b 20.9B total / 3.6B active (gpt-oss-120b's 5.1B lives in manual_params.json). HyperNova 60B 2605 is a CompactifAI compression of gpt-oss-120b; its model card states 59B total / 4.8B active.
_comment_qwen_hybrid: Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 (and Nex-N2-Pro, a post-train of Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) interleave linear attention with full attention — `full_attention_interval: 4` — so the estimator's uniform 4·H² attention term is far too small, and it also misses the untied lm_head. It came out 18-33% under. Values below are exact: every tensor shape was read from the safetensors shard headers, summed to a total matching safetensors.total byte-for-byte, then active = non-expert weights + experts_per_tok/num_experts of the routed experts + embed + lm_head (excludes the vision tower and the MTP head, which is what reproduces Qwen's own A<N>B figures).
_comment_nemotron_3_5: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL / Bolt are Mamba-2/LatentMoE hybrids like the rest of Nemotron-H, which the estimator cannot model (docs/data-sources.md §2), so both plotted dense. Card values: 120B-A12B and 74B-A9B. Bolt was also aliased to the -24GB repo — NVIDIA's IQ2-quantized local build (safetensors.total 22.4B) — instead of the BF16 checkpoint.
